jobs.title: State Product Manager - Personal Lines
jobs.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Broker Product Manager - Personal Lines

Key Responsibilities
- Own P&L objectives for Personal Lines products distributed through brokers nationally
- Partner with sales teams to develop and execute broker distribution strategies
- Establish and monitor KPIs to measure broker performance and identify opportunities for profitable growth
- Translate data and business insights into actionable recommendations for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders

Ideal candidate demonstrates:
- Strong strategic and critical thinking capabilities
- A track record of generating clear, data-driven insights
- Excellent communication skills with ability to influence and align stakeholders
- Experience in state management, agency portfolio management, business insights or distribution analytics preferred

#LI-KP1
#LI-Remote

Job Description Summary
Our work is essential to helping Nationwide build future capability to serve customer needs. Keeping existing products relevant and marketable and building new products takes research, critical thinking, practicality and collaboration. If you enjoy gathering input and information, working independently and on a team and creating innovative solutions for customers, we want to know more about you!

The State Manager creates multi-year state-specific business strategy to drive our Personal Lines Portfolio of products to meet or exceed top and bottom-line performance aligning to enterprise goals and strategy. This position is responsible for driving strategic alignment through the launch and refinement of product offerings (pricing, underwriting appetite and product structure and enhancements) and distribution strategy. This includes developing and implementing plans and processes related to financial planning, rate reviews, market development and communication of state management. Working directly with PL business stakeholders, the State Manager aggressively collaborates in the development, execution and monitoring of operating plans resulting in P&L objectives, including the areas of combined ratio, revenue growth, regulatory management, and legal compliance. The State Manager is responsible for building winning strategies to address complex business issues such as maximizing the opportunity of assigned state markets. Your work will support regional and corporate objectives through ongoing analysis and monitoring of results and communicating results with leadership, distribution and underwriting partners. Keeping existing state strategic direction relevant, competitive, and profitable requires research, critical thinking, practicality and collaboration.
Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
- Develop, implement, and manage strategic plans for assigned states, incorporating top/bottom line performance designed to meet or exceed Personal Lines objectives.

- Owns strategy and performance for assigned state(s).

- Analyzes and reviews financial results, product profitability, business mix and competitive information and forecasts performance.

- Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Claims, Actuarial, Underwriting, Technology, and Legal to align stakeholders in the execution of state-specific strategies.

- Monitor performance, communicate and influence action to address product/pricing issues, strategies, and financial results with appropriate stakeholders and leadership.

- Maintains in-depth knowledge of the personal lines industry, state markets, regulatory environment, and current economic and business trends.

- Develop and maintain formal relationships with state regulatory agencies and trade associations.

- Coordinate and facilitate communication across functions and state management team.

- Applies judgment, understanding and curiosity to data and provides high level analysis considering multiple complexities to build fully developed solutions.

- Communicates information regarding products, pricing and organizational decisions to internal and external partners verbally and in writing. Translates data and strategic concepts into understandable communications to be shared with multiple audiences.

- May participate in cross functional teams to complete projects or support the business. Provides strong leadership, is approachable, and instills trust at all levels.

- Lead all aspects of associate management including performance, salary planning and administration, training and development, workflow and organization planning, day-to-day management, hiring and placement and disciplinary actions for direct reports.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships:  Reports to AVP, State Product Manager – Personal Lines or Sr State Product Manager – Personal Lines. Up to two direct reports and no indirect reports.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education:  Bachelor’s degree in insurance, actuarial science, mathematics, risk management, economics, finance, accounting, business administration or related subject area or Master of Business Administration degree preferred.

License/Certification/Designation:  Progress toward or completion of CPCU, AU CIC, INS ARM, actuarial exams or similar designations preferred.

Experience:  Eight years of experience in underwriting or product preferred. Cross-functional experience from other areas and experience with data analysis preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills:    Detailed knowledge of core business functions, personal lines insurance products and pricing architecture, state regulations, underwriting procedures and standard methodologies. Solid understanding of financials, trend analysis and competitor data. Proficiency in analytical tools, relational databases, data visualization techniques, query-based language and/or statistical software experience preferred. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to present information, communicate and influence internal and external partners at all levels. Skilled in the use of related systems and analytical tools. Ability to drive for results, deal with ambiguity, solve problems, learn on the job, make quality decisions, see trends and patterns within data. Ability to manage projects, opposing priorities, timelines and resources to complete work. Strong organizational agility and political savvy preferred.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner. Depending on level, the approvers may change.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility:  Not Eligible (Exempt)

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering Product Manager (Workforce & Legal Tech)
jobs.description:
If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

We are seeking an experienced technology leader to support the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of Nationwide's Office of the Chief Legal Officer (OCLO) technology portfolio. OCLO provides legal, regulatory, compliance, ethics, governance, and risk management support across Nationwide, and this role enables those functions through secure, reliable, innovative, and business-aligned technology solutions.
The position oversees a portfolio of 46 applications (34 SaaS and 12 COTS solutions) that manage confidential, privileged, and sensitive information. Success in this role requires a strong understanding of SaaS platforms and technology portfolio management, including the ability to guide buy-versus-build decisions, challenge existing assumptions, introduce practical innovation, and ensure consistent delivery in a highly visible environment.
This leader will partner closely with the Technology Product Manager, OCLO business leaders, Architecture, Security, Data, Infrastructure, and external vendors to shape strategy, influence prioritization, and drive execution.

The Successful Candidate Will Be
- Strategic : Able to establish a compelling platform and product vision while connecting technology investments to business outcomes.
- Technically Credible : Able to challenge assumptions, influence architecture decisions, and understand modern engineering practices.
- Product-Minded : Focused on customer outcomes and business value rather than simply delivering technology.
- Collaborative and Influential : Able to align teams, leaders, vendors, and stakeholders across organizational boundaries.
- Execution-Oriented : Able to translate strategy into measurable outcomes and consistent delivery.
- People-Focused : Committed to developing talent and fostering an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture.
- Forward-Looking : Understands how AI, automation, platform engineering, and emerging technologies are transforming enterprise software delivery.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead teams responsible for the enhancement, integration, support, and operational health of the OCLO technology ecosystem.
- Partner with the Technology Product Manager and business leaders to define priorities, shape roadmaps, and translate strategic objectives into executable plans.
- Drive delivery excellence across discovery, planning, development, testing, deployment, and production support while continuously improving engineering and delivery practices.
- Manage technology vendor relationships, including performance management, escalations, renewals, service issues, and stakeholder alignment; facilitate productive discussions between vendors and internal business partners.
- Ensure solutions meet applicable security, privacy, compliance, data governance, records management, and information protection requirements.
- Evaluate and apply AI-enabled development practices, automation, and emerging technologies to improve productivity, testing, documentation, operations, and user experiences.
- Communicate technical concepts, risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and financial considerations effectively to both technical and business audiences.
- Manage team capacity, financial risks, technology investments, and build-and-run budgets while adapting to changing priorities and constraints.
- Challenge conventional thinking, identify opportunities for continuous improvement, and promote pragmatic solutions that accelerate business value.
- Develop and coach team members while strengthening organizational capabilities and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.

Qualifications & Experience
- Experience leading technology teams responsible for the development, integration, enhancement, and support of enterprise application portfolios.
- Experience supporting SaaS and packaged software solutions within complex business environments.
- Experience with cloud-native architectures, modern data platforms, Agile delivery models, product operating models, and AI-enabled development practices.
- Demonstrated success managing technology vendors, including performance management, escalations, service delivery, renewals, and stakeholder alignment.
- Experience leading, coaching, and developing technology professionals.
- Strong financial management acumen, including business case development, budget planning, and technology portfolio governance.
- Excellent communication, executive presence, collaboration, negotiation, and influencing skills.
- Ability to operate effectively in highly regulated environments where confidentiality, privacy, privilege, compliance, and risk management are critical.

This role offers a Hybrid work environment and will be located in Columbus, OH .

#LI-BG1

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering Product Manager (NF) - Post-Issue Optimization
jobs.description:
If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Software Engineering Product Manager (SEPM)
Do you want to help lead one of the most important AI-enabled transformations in Nationwide Financial? Join the Metacortex line within Digital Servicing and help shape PIO, a bold effort to reinvent how post-issue servicing works.

This is an opportunity to sit at the intersection of product strategy, engineering execution, and AI innovation. As the Software Engineering Product Manager (SEPM), you will help turn complex business challenges into scalable digital capabilities, using AI-DLC to move from bold ideas to production outcomes with speed, discipline, and purpose. You will help guide teams building smarter servicing experiences, reduce manual effort, improve operational performance, and create measurable value for customers, employees, and the business.

This role is not about maintaining the status quo. It is about setting a new direction for how Nationwide Financial delivers technology and serves its customers. You will help define the roadmap, align leaders and delivery teams, remove barriers, and create the operating rhythm needed to turn transformation into results. The person in this role must bring deep technical credibility, genuine curiosity, and the ability to lead people at their very best. You should be comfortable going deep with engineers on architecture, APIs, AI patterns, and delivery mechanics, while also creating trust, growing talent, and protecting the collaborative culture that makes this space special. If you are energized by leading through ambiguity, challenging conventional thinking, and helping build the future with AI, this is the opportunity.

What you will lead
- Set and communicate the product and technology vision for PIO, connecting the roadmap to Nationwide Financial priorities and measurable business outcomes.
- Lead complex, cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, architecture, operations, and AI-DLC teams, creating alignment from strategy through production.
- Translate emerging AI capabilities into practical solutions that simplify post-issue servicing, improve speed and quality, and reduce manual effort.
- Champion the decision-making framework, delivery cadence, and accountability model needed to move a high-visibility transformation forward with urgency and clarity.
- Stay close enough to the technology to challenge assumptions, evaluate tradeoffs, ask the hard questions, and earn the trust of highly technical teams.
- Remove obstacles, challenge outdated ways of working, and create momentum when priorities, dependencies, or technical complexity threaten progress.
- Partner with senior leaders to shape investment decisions, manage tradeoffs, surface risks early, and keep the work connected to business value.
- Recruit, coach, and develop exceptional people while preserving the culture of collaboration, curiosity, and ownership that makes the space successful.
- Inspire a culture of innovation, experimentation, psychological safety, and engineering excellence across the broader team.
- Total ownership of AI assets aligned to the Post-Issue Optimization effort
- Cross business unit (Retirement, Life, Annuity) collaboration to drive program outcomes.

Why this role is different
- You will help shape an AI-enabled operating model, not simply deliver another technology project.
- You will have a direct hand in turning AI-DLC practices into repeatable ways of delivering business value.
- You will work on highly visible capabilities that can change how Nationwide Financial serves customers and operates at scale.
- You will influence both what gets built and how the organization builds it.
- You will help create the conditions for strong teams to move faster, learn continuously, and deliver with confidence.
- You will be both a technical leader and a culture carrier—someone who can raise the bar without losing the spirit that makes the team great.

What will set you apart
- Hands-on experience building, delivering, or scaling AI-enabled products and capabilities.
- Experience working across Nationwide, with the ability to connect teams, navigate enterprise complexity, and turn relationships into progress.
- A track record of translating emerging technology into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes.
- Examples of how you drove high performing teams with excellent levels of engagement.

If you are ready to lead meaningful change, turn AI innovation into enterprise impact, and help build what is next for Nationwide Financial, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

This role will work a hybrid schedule coming into the Columbus, Ohio office 2 days (Mondays & Tuesdays) per week. Remote internal associates may also be considered.

jobs.title: Specialty Insurance Product Owner (Consultant)
jobs.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

The Specialty Insurance Product Owner, Management Liability Specialty Operations, is accountable for maximizing the value of products and capabilities supporting MLS operations and related specialty insurance areas. The role may span MLS, including Surety Bonds, Credit and Political Risk, and other related product areas.

The Product Owner partners with business leaders, operations teams, broker/agent partners, customers, underwriters, technology, data, compliance, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into a prioritized roadmap, quality releases, and measurable business outcomes. This role is comfortable creating clarity from ambiguity, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and balancing customer value, operational effectiveness, risk, compliance, budget, and technical feasibility.

Key Responsibilities
Product strategy, roadmap ownership, and market awareness
- Define and maintain the product vision, roadmap, priorities, and desired outcomes for assigned capabilities.
- Develop a strong understanding of MLS Operations, related product areas, users, workflows, pain points, market needs, and applicable regulatory or control considerations.
- Engage business stakeholders, operations teams, customers, broker/agent partners, and other users to validate problems, gather feedback, and define measurable outcomes.
- Monitor competitors, market trends, and evolving capabilities to help MLS remain relevant and keep pace in the marketplace.
- Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, operational effectiveness, decision support, automation, data quality, and controls.

Backlog, delivery, and distribution partnership
- Own and prioritize the product backlog in JIRA, including epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and release targets.
- Translate complex business processes and rules into clear requirements that delivery teams can execute.
- Partner with technology, architecture, engineering, QA, data, security, operations, and vendors through refinement, development, testing, release, adoption, and production support.
- Provide timely decisions, clarifications, and trade-off recommendations to maintain delivery momentum and avoid rework.
- Confirm that completed work meets acceptance criteria, intended outcomes, and release-readiness expectations.
- Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate discovery, analysis, documentation, story development, test design, and other product activities while protecting confidential information.
- Use prototypes, workflow mockups, wireframes, process concepts, and rapid experimentation to validate ideas before significant delivery investment.
- Build effective relationships with distribution partners and involve them early in discovery to validate proposed workflows and capabilities.
- Design and coordinate pilot testing with selected distribution partners when appropriate; establish clear objectives and success criteria, gather structured feedback, and incorporate feasible enhancements before broader release.

Business cases, budget, and outcomes
- Identify opportunities and develop business cases for review and submission, clearly describing the problem or opportunity, recommended approach, expected value, measurable benefits, investment and resource needs, costs, risks, dependencies, and implementation considerations.
- Partner closely with the Project Manager, SEPM, and Agile Leader to maintain accurate forecasts, monitor expenditures against approved maintenance funding and business-case budgets, address variances, and escalate risks or required decisions promptly.
- Define success measures, baselines, key performance indicators, adoption measures, and benefits-realization plans for projects and initiatives.
- Showcase and demonstrate measurable outcomes through product demonstrations, stakeholder readouts, dashboards, status reporting, or other appropriate forums.

Risk, governance and continuous improvement
- Ensure product decisions and delivery practices account for regulatory obligations, privacy, security, auditability, records, data governance, and enterprise policies.
- Partner with compliance, legal, risk, security, architecture, and governance functions to identify and address risks early.
- Maintain clear documentation of product decisions, business rules, assumptions, controls, integrations, data flows, business cases, budget status, and outcome results.
- Monitor product performance, adoption, customer feedback, defects, operational results, and financial performance; use those insights to guide prioritization and improvement.
- Make timely, well-reasoned decisions through ambiguity and escalate material risks while retaining ownership of recommendations and next steps

What you bring
- Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, Application Owner, or similar role in a complex business environment.
- Experience working in insurance, financial services, specialty products, operations, underwriting, risk management, or a related domain.
- Experience managing a product backlog in JIRA or a comparable Agile delivery tool and writing actionable stories and acceptance criteria.
- Experience partnering with technology teams and distribution partners through discovery, delivery, testing, pilot activities, release, adoption, and production support.
- Experience developing business cases, defining success measures, tracking budgets, and demonstrating measurable outcomes.
- Comfort using AI tools and rapid prototyping techniques with sound judgment regarding accuracy, confidentiality, security, and responsible use.
- Ability to make decisions and move work forward through ambiguity, evolving requirements, competing priorities, and imperfect information.
- Strong analytical, facilitation, communication, organization, and stakeholder-influence skills.
- Ability to balance customer experience, business value, operational practicality, risk, compliance, budget, and technical feasibility.
- Ability to influence outcomes without direct authority in a matrixed environment.
- Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, computer science, insurance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with specialty insurance, enterprise platforms, workflow automation, APIs, integrations, decision-support tools, or data-intensive applications.
- Experience with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Lean, product discovery, design thinking, or hybrid delivery models.
- Experience with customer research, usability testing, service design, journey mapping, or process improvement.
- Experience defining product metrics, dashboards, adoption measures, service-level measures, or business cases.
- Familiarity with AI-enabled workflows, responsible AI practices, rapid prototyping tools, or automation concepts.

Measures of Success
- The roadmap and backlog reflect clear business outcomes, customer needs, market awareness, risk considerations, dependencies, and measurable value.
- Delivery teams have the clarity, context, decisions, acceptance criteria, and stakeholder access needed to deliver quality outcomes.
- Releases are appropriately tested, piloted when warranted, informed by distribution-partner feedback, and ready for adoption and production support.
- Approved maintenance and business-case budgets are accurately forecasted, actively monitored, and managed within approved funding.
- Product performance, adoption, customer feedback, defects, and business outcomes are measured and used to guide investment and prioritization decisions.
- Project and initiative goals are demonstrated through measurable results, stakeholder reporting, and benefits-realization evidence.
- Product decisions are timely, transparent, evidence-informed, and appropriately documented.
- AI, prototyping, and continuous improvement practices accelerate learning while managing confidentiality, security, compliance, and operational risk.

Role Expectations
A successful Product Owner is curious about the business, close to users, comfortable with technology, and accountable for outcomes beyond delivery alone. They bring structure without unnecessary bureaucracy, communicate directly, test assumptions, collaborate effectively with distribution partners and delivery teams, and know when to decide, experiment, seek input, or escalate.

*This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.*
